title: 国家经济排名
problem_statement_md:
你正在处理代表国家经济排名的数据。
每个国家的名字**name**和排名**rank**都存储在一个字典中，键是国家名称。

完善程序，输入国名，并输出其经济排名。
如果输入的国名在数据中不存在，则输出 "**Not found**"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Dictionary Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working on data that represents the economic freedom rank by country.
Each country [b]name[/b] and [b]rank[/b] are stored in a dictionary, with the key being the country name.

Complete the program to take the country name as input and output its corresponding economic freedom rank.
In case the provided country name is not present in the data, output "[b]Not found[/b]".
[note]Recall the [b]get[/b]() method of a dictionary, that allows you to specify a default value.[/note]
hint_md: 回顾字典的`get()`方法，它允许你指定一个默认值。
